liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): With the audience patches, Sugaree runs nearly 17 full minutes; Reviewer names this Sugaree their all-time favorite [10][17]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): This release has Row Jimmy uncut, which earlier circulating copies reportedly lacked [10]
- **Sunrise** (1 review): Reviewer jokingly wishes Sunrise, a Donna song, had been left out [19]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Reviewer, who attended the show and over 150 others, calls this Jack-A-Roe possibly the best they have ever heard [9]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer rates the Bertha into Good Lovin' among the best the band ever did [18]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Ramble On Rose is called a nice surprise in the second set [18]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): Brokedown is settling into its encore spot, but Jerry has not yet fixed the verse and solo structure [13]

## The recordings

- **gd77-06-08.sbd.clugston.15421.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 187 min; rated 4.8/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: This copy has static in Sugaree, from the reel and PCM generations [12]
- **gd1977-06-08.mtx.seamons.95361.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 200 min; rated 4.92/5 by 12 [3]
- **gd77-06-08.sbd.miller.25621.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 202 min; rated 4.75/5 by 12 [4]
- **gd1977-06-08.sbd.parmer.4184.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer graduated high school this night and missed all three shows of the run [14]
- Reviewer's birthday fell on this date, and they were glad of Passenger and Lazy Lightning into Supplication [19]
- The mix of delicate and powerful playing is likened to the 5/22 Morning Dew [13]
- Reviewer finds 1977 shows consistently strong, with song selection varying little across the year [16]
- Reviewer likes the first set less than the following night, 6/9/77, a personal favorite show [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-06-08.sbd.clugston.15421.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Reel > Reel to Reel > PCM> DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Betty's soundboard recording has circulated for years; this version adds audience-recording patches; A newer version via Charlie Miller skips the reel and PCM generations, so it avoids that static; Reviewer has owned a good audience cassette of set 1 since the 1980s [1][10][12][13]
- **gd1977-06-08.mtx.seamons.95361.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Recorded by Rob Bertrando using AKG D224 microphones into a Tandberg 10XD at 7.5 ips; Transferred and edited by Charlie Miller from source discs supplied by Paul Scotton [3]
- **gd77-06-08.sbd.miller.25621.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD Transfer Info: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude v7.02 Profesional ->… [4]. Also: Reviewer played an old audience cassette of set 1 for twenty years [17]
- **gd1977-06-08.sbd.parmer.4184.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by EAC > SHN by Jason Parmer; source: SBDMR > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 6/8/77 Winterland Arena, San …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27089455140/) [22]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27089455140/) [23]
